title: Birds Dont Sing
lyrics:
[00:18.18]She said, "How could you joke at a time like this?
[00:26.12]I know why, 'cause this is what you wanted all along now, isn't it?
[00:35.09]I think that all you ever really ever wanted was a reason to complain
[00:45.23]That never stopped you before, don't let it get in your way"
[00:53.41]Those are her words, not mine
[00:58.18]As far as I'm concerned, we could've had a good time
[01:02.06]So, if you walk out that door in disgust
[01:07.74]I guess there's nothing more to discuss
[01:12.00]Birds don't sing, they just fall from the sky
[01:16.50]Girls don't call and they never tell you why
[01:22.09]That's just how they say goodbye
[01:28.60]Goodbye
[01:47.67]Don't listen to my music, don't lie in my bed
[01:56.69]Don't listen to the references to things you might have actually said
[02:05.15]'Cause those are my words, not yours
[02:10.21]As far as I'm concerned, it could have been a lot worse
[02:15.32]I wasn't trying to avoid the confrontation
[02:19.71]She isn't crying, she's just making conversation
[02:24.04]Birds don't sing, they just fall from the sky
[02:28.55]Girls don't call and they never tell you why
[02:34.11]That's just how they say goodbye
[02:40.60]Goodbye
